- closed form vs autograd: 3.6x (N=16384) to 20x; closed form flat at ~0.27 ms up to N=4096 (launch bound), then ~linear in N.
- MPR full run ~0.11 s up to N=4096, 1.09 s at N=32768; SR one sweep grows linearly (7.1 s at N=32768).
